observation.command: docker run --rm postgis/postgis:17-3.5-alpine sh -c 'postgres --version 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/os-release | grep VERSION; echo "--- ext ---"; ls /usr/local/share/postgresql/extension/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i "postgis\|pgrouting" | head; find / -name "postgis.control" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- apk ---"; apk list 2>/dev/null | grep -i pgrouting' 2>&1 | tail -20
